pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with variable edge angularity. Individual patches on the flank display irregular geometric forms with soft pixel gradients at the boundaries. Spatial density of patches is high with moderate separation.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-toned lattice separating the dark patches. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Corridor thickness remains relatively consistent across the mid-flank, with some narrowing towards the dorsal ridge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency bristly silhouette visible along the cervical and thoracic dorsal line. The mane presents a dense, continuous textural contrast against the background.
